name: Heat and PM2.5 compound exposure study
description: Measures how particulate concentrations behave on heatwave days across three Southeast Asian cities.
quick_insights: PM2.5 concentrations 4.1% higher on heatwave days. Compound exposure raises cardiovascular risk beyond either factor alone.

name: Air pollution convenings learning note
description: Internal synthesis of three convenings on urban air quality in the region.
quick_insights: Vulnerable populations lack agency to act on air quality warnings even where warnings exist.

name: Clean cooking outcome bond brief
description: Describes a $200M outcome bond instrument financing clean cooking transitions.
quick_insights: $200M instrument issued. Annual clean cooking funding gap estimated at $8B globally.

name: Jakarta air quality review
description: Review of monitoring coverage and exceedance patterns in Greater Jakarta.
quick_insights: Monitoring stations concentrated in central districts. Peri-urban exposure largely unmeasured.

name: Mekong water security assessment
description: Assessment of dry-season water availability and upstream abstraction in the lower Mekong.
quick_insights: Dry-season flows declining. Downstream provinces report increasing salinity intrusion.

name: Urban waste management policy brief
description: Policy options for municipal solid waste handling in secondary Indonesian cities.
quick_insights: Collection coverage below 60% outside provincial capitals. No costed national implementation plan identified.

name: Community water kiosk programme, Mekong Delta
description: Evaluation of a community-run water kiosk model operating in twelve communes of the Mekong Delta since 2019. Kiosks treat and sell water at subsidised prices, run by local cooperatives.
quick_insights: Twelve kiosks operating after five years; 78% still financially self-sustaining at year three. Evaluation notes the model relied on existing commune-level permitting and on households already paying private vendors for water. No replication outside the Delta provinces reported.

name: Indonesia rural water access baseline
description: Baseline survey of drinking water access across rural districts in Java and Sulawesi.
quick_insights: Piped coverage reaches 41% of surveyed rural households. Most remaining households rely on private vendors or untreated sources. Willingness-to-pay not assessed. District permitting arrangements for community utilities vary widely and are not catalogued.

name: Southeast Asia water utility financing note
description: Industry note on financing structures used by small water utilities across the region.
quick_insights: Community-run utilities rarely reach the scale required for commercial lending. Concessional finance is the usual route where it exists.
